intro.text: Foes the Knights Radiant fought in the days before the Recreance, among them the Midnight Essence.

description.text: In Radiant belief, battling the Deaths changes a person and can in time destroy them.

items.text: Unlike the Voidbringers, the Deaths could strike in the long years between Desolations. The Radiants based in Alethela counted them as a chief threat in those times and trained to fight them.
One Radiant spoke of someone having to release the Midnight Essence.
